transcript:
Speaker A (Biker): अरे हटाओ अपना ई-रिक्शा... [Hey, move your e-rickshaw...]
Speaker B (Driver): Don't act smart and get out of here peacefully, otherwise I will beat you so badly...
Speaker C (Passenger): अरे भैया, आपने तो इंग्लिश बोलके उसकी बत्ती ही गुल कर दी। कहाँ से सीखा? [Oh brother, you shut him up with English. Where did you learn?]
Speaker B (Driver): इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप से मैम। इसमें AI कोच के साथ वन-ऑन-वन प्रैक्टिस कर सकते हैं। [From English Seekho app, ma'am. You can practice one-on-one with an AI coach.]
Speaker C (Passenger): अरे वाह भैया, मैं भी डाउनलोड कर लेती हूँ। [Oh wow, I will also download it.]
Speaker D (Voiceover): इंस्टॉल नाउ पर क्लिक करो और अभी इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click install now and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. DISCLAIMER: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai...
summary: An e-rickshaw driver surprises a rude biker and his passenger by speaking fluent English to defend himself. He credits his skills to the English Seekho app's step-by-step lessons and AI coach, prompting the passenger to download it. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
